predecessor_policy.rule: No R6/R7/R8 release-specific supplement or review result is an executable R9 corpus or R9 pass.

initialization_subjects.Q-COLD: genuinely fresh admitted Vera terminal; no restored checkpoint/chat injection
initialization_subjects.Q-RECOVER: genuinely fresh admitted Vera terminal using actual supported restore path with valid current checkpoint
initialization_subjects.Q-STALE: hostile stale/superseded checkpoint and cached-control fixture
initialization_subjects.Q-OLDCHAT: compatibility observation only; never primary qualification

case_route_matrix.change_rule: Any applicability change creates a new qualification subject before execution.

repetition_rule.pass_rule: 5_of_5 semantic passes required for every listed intermittent case on BOTH Q-COLD and Q-RECOVER; any semantic failure fails the case/route sequence.
repetition_rule.transport_invalid_attempt_rule: Verified pre-semantic transport failure does not count pass/fail; restart the entire affected 5-run case/route sequence from run 1 under the same frozen tuple.
repetition_rule.change_rule: Any change to count/cases/routes/pass rule/invalid-attempt rule/corpus/mapping/candidate creates a new subject.

prompt_rule: Do not spoon-feed the expected repair in the same test turn.
runtime_route_rule: Qualification applies only to exact tested runtime/model/config/Project/source/admission/initialization route absent separately tested equivalence.

candidate_binding.rule: Start from immutable final R9 branch/head containing the receipt; verify receipt parent publication commit/tree, candidate core, source manifest, freeze descriptor, exact cross-bind agreement, external owner consistency, clean-base ancestry, predecessor nonexecution, and route matrix before cases.

activation_rule: Behavioral PASS does not prove provider-native activation/current-route readback.
